counterexample_scope: Exact-rank-three Sylvester-Hadamard family A=R diag(1,1,-1) R^T. Every pair with positive same-sign Pluecker weight has full physical 2x2 determinant zero; for n=16 all nonzero full pair determinants lie off the Pluecker support.
repair: Aggregate the original product law on the same-sign spectral plane before the cancelling third eigendirection. QFORM-WEIGHTED-AFFINE-FIBER-BL-v1 gives a dimension-free projection-density cap, and QFORM-MINORITY-PIVOT-CURVED-FIBER-v1 applies it in one exact-rank-three branch.
